verify_detail: ## Why DO NOT SHIP\nNo crashes, ANRs, or memory issues were observed, and simple flows (navigation, text entry, toggles, list scrolling/paging, quantity stepper bounds) are solid. However, the Checkout total bug is a real billing-correctness defect, and the Tier-not-saved bug corrupts submitted data — both are core-functionality failures, not polish issues. Combined with two dead buttons and a validation gap, this build should not ship until at least defects #1 and #2 are fixed and re-verified.'
